items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: he knew how to play most all the instruments, and he would show you how to hold sticks.

ctx.x: You impressed the beat on the seat of your pants, right?

So I started with a little snare drum. And there was a gentleman who used to come around the schools in the Port Chester area, he was a colonel in the Marines, his name was Paul Weckesser. And anybody that wanted to learn, he knew how to play most all the instruments, and he would show you how to hold sticks. Or if somebody went for the trumpet or trombone, he knew basic little things in there. And that was the start of it. And then I worked my way up to the first set I got was one with like we call a pool table…
Well this had to be great preparation for your eventual career as a bassist I would think.
